ITEM 6. SELECTED CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL DATA.
The fiscal years presented below are for the respective twelve-month period from January 1 through December 31.
Data for all years was derived or compiled from our audited consolidated financial statements included herein or from
submissions of our Form 10-K in prior years. The selected consolidated financial data should be read in conjunction
with our consolidated financial statements and related notes contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

IT_2007_p66__caption_0.ocr: The following items impact the comparability of our consolidated data from continuing operations:

IT_2007_p66__paragraph_1.ocr:
• The results of META Group, Inc. (“META”) are included in our consolidated results beginning April 1, 2005, the date
of acquisition.

IT_2007_p66__paragraph_2.ocr:
• We repurchased 8.4 million, 14.9 million, 0.8 million, 26.6 million, and 5.0 million of our common shares in 2007,
2006, 2005, 2004, and 2003, respectively.

IT_2007_p66__title_0.ocr: • In 2003 certain long-term debt held by Silver Lake was converted into equity.

IT_2007_p66__paragraph_3.ocr:
• We had pre-tax stock compensation expense of $24.1 million and $16.7 million in 2007 and 2006, respectively,
under Statement of Financial Accounting Standards 123(R), “Share-Based Payment.” We adopted this statement
on January 1, 2006, under the modified prospective transition method. • During 2006 and 2005 we recorded $1.5 million and $15.0 million, respectively, in pre-tax charges related to the
integration of META. • We recorded Other charges, which includes costs for severance, excess facilities, and other items, on a pre-tax
basis, of $9.1 million in 2007, $0 in 2006, $29.2 million in 2005, $35.8 million in 2004, and $29.7 million in 2003.

IT_2007_p66__paragraph_4.ocr:
• We recorded pre-tax goodwill impairment charges of $2.7 million in 2004. In the same year, we had $3.1 million of
pre-tax foreign currency charges related to the closing of certain operations in South America.

IT_2007_p66__paragraph_5.ocr:
• We recorded pre-tax charges for the impairment of investments of $5.3 million in 2005, $3.0 million in 2004, and
$0.9 million for 2003.

IT_2007_p66__paragraph_6.ocr:
• We had pre-tax losses (gains) on investments or assets and associated insurance claims of $(0.5) million in 2005,
$5.5 million in 2003, and $0.5 million in 2002.
